evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics generated within two hours, including observation timestamps and source commit.
Per-trade capital-at-risk and time-weighted exposure needed to calculate money-weighted returns and drawdown.
Receipt- or wallet-reconciled gross proceeds, principal, DEX/platform fees, realised slippage and price impact, gas/base/priority/Jito fees, rent paid/reclaimed and failed-attempt spend.
Explicit causal labels separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures, with RPC, quote, simulation, signing, broadcast, landing, revert and reconciliation subtypes.
Eligible-opportunity, rejection, participation and no-edge counts by strategy and chain, including counterfactual outcomes for rejected signals.
Out-of-sample cost-complete SHADOW round trips by strategy, asset, chain and market regime; quote-only projections are insufficient.
Execution latency, quote age, landing/fill rate, revert rate, retry cost, adverse-selection and partial-fill distributions.
Chain-normalised valuation at trade time plus portfolio cash flows for valid cross-chain money weighting.
Tail-loss, maximum drawdown and concentration results, including unsellable-token and emergency-exit outcomes.
Evidence that all Strategy Lab net-P&L inputs reconcile to immutable execution records and cannot omit costs.

Only after these gaps are satisfied: independent out-of-sample evidence with positive capital-weighted NET P&L, adequate lower confidence bounds, acceptable drawdown and execution reliability before any promotion consideration.

proposals.downside_risk: Schema complexity and historical rows with incomplete components may reduce usable sample size; fail closed by marking them cost-incomplete rather than imputing favourable results.

evidence.detail: record_strategy_window accepts caller-supplied net_profit and otherwise derives only gross_profit minus gross_loss, fees and slippage; it does not validate supplied net against components or separately capture price impact, gas/priority fees, failed-attempt cost and infrastructure loss.

record_canary_result separates execution_failure counts from realised_net_base, but stores only an undifferentiated reason and can advance stages from aggregate net/PF without cost-completeness metadata.
Solana receipt records already expose network, priority/Jito, platform-fee, rent, wallet-delta, price-impact and execution-P&L fields that could feed richer attribution.

EVM realised cycle P&L uses wrapped-balance delta minus actual receipt gas, while rejected executions are recorded separately without an explicit strategy/market versus execution/infrastructure taxonomy.

proposals.expected_effect: Auditable per-trade and per-window net returns after all costs, with strategy quality evaluated separately from execution reliability and no cross-chain unit mixing.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent eligible opportunities and 20 executable simulated or paper-filled round trips per chain, spanning at least 7 days and multiple congestion/volatility regimes; report capital-weighted return, drawdown, cost coverage and failure taxonomy separately.
proposals.rationale: Durable selection requires comparable money-weighted NET P&L and explicit causal attribution. A negative executable trade should be STRATEGY/MARKET loss; quote, simulation, RPC, signing, broadcast, landing or reconciliation faults should be EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures, including any gas lost. Collapsing these dimensions can replace sound signals because of infrastructure faults or retain weak signals whose costs are incomplete.
proposals.shadow_test: For every SHADOW opportunity, replay an immutable cost ledger in chain-native units and a timestamped common reporting currency. Require net = proceeds minus principal minus DEX/platform fees minus realised slippage/impact minus gas/priority/Jito minus non-refunded rent and failure spend. Reconcile component totals to wallet/receipt deltas within a predefined rounding tolerance. Stop and mark the window invalid on missing mandatory costs, unexplained residuals, mixed units, or any causal-classification ambiguity.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative reserves can suppress activity, but absence of a positive executable edge should correctly produce no trade.

evidence.detail: SHADOW events persist fee_base and slippage_base but lack dedicated gas/priority, price-impact, platform-fee, rent, failed-attempt cost and fill/landing fields; quote simulations are correctly marked as non-promotion evidence.
Solana entry-edge logic reserves current round-trip deterioration, two-leg slippage, network fees and latency, demonstrating chain-specific economics that generic SHADOW rows should preserve.
EVM simulation reserves 30% above estimated gas at maxFeePerGas/gasPrice and requires quoted gross edge to cover gas plus configured minimum net profit.

proposals.expected_effect: More conservative opportunity ranking and fewer false-positive edges caused by omitted or mismodelled chain-specific friction.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 eligible observations and 30 cost-complete round trips on each chain over 14 days, including high-fee/congestion periods; no promotion from quote-only outcomes.
proposals.rationale: A single expected-edge number is insufficient across Solana and EVM. Solana needs compute/priority or Jito costs, account-rent treatment, Jupiter platform fees, route impact and landing reliability. EVM needs EIP-1559/legacy gas economics, approval/preparation costs, reverts, nonce/replacement failures, MEV exposure and receipt-confirmed gas.
proposals.shadow_test: Compare predicted all-in net edge at signal time with delayed executable quote/simulation and paper-fill outcome separately on Solana and EVM. Include failed-attempt costs and classify each miss as MARKET/STRATEGY decay or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. Reject the hypothesis if median signed prediction error is adverse, the lower confidence bound of capital-weighted net P&L is non-positive, or cost coverage falls below 100%.

proposals.downside_risk: Potential false negatives and lower participation during transient infrastructure degradation; measure these as skipped opportunities or infrastructure failures, not strategy losses.

evidence.detail: Solana rejects missing price-impact evidence and requires route-level simulation.
Solana bounds combined impact/slippage, total fees and rent exposure while recording receipt economics.
EVM cycle simulation requires gross edge to cover conservative gas reserve and minimum net profit, and fails on simulation/gas-estimation errors.
Lifecycle logic explicitly avoids punishing a strategy when no eligible opportunity exists and does not auto-promote LIVE.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves capital during absent-edge, illiquid, high-impact or unreliable-execution conditions.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 gate decisions per chain across 14 days, with complete rejection reasons, counterfactual outcomes and chain-specific costs.
proposals.rationale: These controls align with the objective: do not manufacture trades, do not weaken liquidity or sellability protection, and require executable edge after chain-specific friction.
proposals.shadow_test: Shadow-log every rejection with contemporaneous quotes, costs and subsequent counterfactual outcome. Keep the gates unless cost-complete counterfactuals show statistically durable positive money-weighted net P&L for rejected trades without increased tail loss or failure rate. Stop immediately if any proposed relaxation admits missing impact, failed simulation, unsellable assets or non-positive executable edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy to CANARY or LIVE from the current evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and quote/simulation economics are explicitly non-promotion evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader or strategy selection primarily by win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not money-weighted and can conceal a small number of large losses or material execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Relax simulation, sellability, liquidity, price-impact, slippage or fee gates to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: More activity without positive executable edge conflicts with the objective and increases tail and execution risk.

rejected_ideas.idea: Aggregate raw SOL and EVM-native P&L into one portfolio total.
rejected_ideas.reason: Native units and capital values are incomparable without timestamped valuation and explicit capital weighting.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains substantial fail-closed execution protection and distinguishes execution-failure counts from realised trading results, but Strategy Lab and SHADOW records do not yet provide a complete, chain-normalised, money-weighted net-P&L attribution covering every executable cost and failure. Solana has explicit impact, slippage, priority-fee, platform-fee and refundable-rent handling; EVM has fresh simulation, gas reserves and receipt gas accounting. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is permitted because current runtime forensics are unavailable.
